<!-- What this changes, as an app sees it, and the issue it fixes. -->

- [ ] `bun run lint:fix`, `bun run check` and the tests of what changed pass
- [ ] a test covers the change, failing without it for a bug fix
- [ ] `llms/` and `docs/src/content/docs/` say what changed
- [ ] a breaking change adds its entry to the upgrade guide (`llms/upgrading.md`)
